property_summary: For any input amount passed to AdjustBetAmounts by the owner, the reference contract sets betLimit to that amount (i.e., betLimit equals the provided amount after the call); the mutant that always sets betLimit to 0 violates this rule for any non-zero amount.
change_summary: Replace betLimit = amount; with betLimit = 0; so AdjustBetAmounts always sets betLimit to zero.
